summary: The sealed restore utility passed an independent actual local primary restore (25 segments, all 600 members, 157 source pins), the 11-case remote audit suite, and four additional strict-metadata/member-digest controls. Review requires amendment because CLI help promises existing paths are never overwritten, but the no-renameat2 os.rename fallback can replace a directory created after its precheck; a controlled fallback-race witness reproduces this. Requested narrow fix: fail closed if Linux renameat2(RENAME_NOREPLACE) is unavailable; do not add another OS implementation.
requested_remedy: Fail closed when renameat2(RENAME_NOREPLACE) is unavailable or unsupported; remove the os.rename fallback. Bound the guarantee/test profile to Linux with renameat2.
limitations: No actual audit archive was available; audit controls used the specified synthetic remote schema.
Offline Go and HTTP asset checks remain sealed E-RESTORE author evidence and were not rerun here.
macOS and Windows were not run; no cross-platform safety claim is accepted.
No production utility, source bundle, or E-RESTORE metadata/report/receipt was modified.
